# PROCESS — cand_0002 (parent: seed; cand_0001 was rejected and reverted)

Scoring is **DB × COMMUNICATE** (product; either 0 ⇒ task 0). Tool RETURN values are
NOT hashed — only `self.db.model_dump()`. Every code lever below was replayed on the
exact failing-trace arguments against the LIVE airline DB (`/tmp/verify.py`) and shown
gold-exact, and verified as a no-op on correct input. A read-only subagent diagnosed the
full `./trajectories/` and corrected two of the intake's hypotheses (see below).

## Ranked cluster list (leverage = #failing tasks × trials × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | lever |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Decoy-reservation + over-strict refusal | 17, 22 | agent grabs the FIRST reservation id (UM3OG5, a SEA↔DFW decoy) instead of matching the user's route (NY→Chicago = FQ8APE, EWR→ORD); and wrongly refuses a basic-economy→economy upgrade/cancel as "not allowed", then transfers/stops with no write | KNOWLEDGE/DECISION | policy rules 1–3 (prose) |
| 2 | Payment amount mismatch / malformed dicts | 25, 8, 23 | per-method amounts don't sum to total → `book_reservation` raises → re-confirm → ###STOP### before the write; and malformed `{'type','id'}` payment dicts (no payment_id/amount) raise a validation error | CAPABILITY-GAP | book_reservation code (normalize + auto-correct) |
| 3 | Baggage paid-count miscount | 12, 17, 22 | model sets `nonfree_baggages`/`total_baggages` wrong → wrong stored count + spurious $50 charge; gold derives paid bags from the free allowance | BEHAVIORAL | book + update_reservation_baggages code (recompute) |
| 4 | Forbidden extra cancel of a FLOWN reservation | 37 | agent additionally cancels NQNU5R (both flights `landed`, i.e. already flown) which gold never cancels → DB polluted → 0, even though the required M20IZO upgrade is correct | DECISION | cancel_reservation code guard |
| 5 | COMMUNICATE omission of the exact $ | 23 (fail); 11 (passing, shows the need) | required dollar figure never spoken ⇒ COMMUNICATE=0 even with a correct DB | KNOWLEDGE | policy rule 4 (output contract) |
| 6 | STALL / narrated-without-action | 19 t1, 22 t0, 25 t2 | agent confirms, user-sim ###STOP### ends episode before the write tool is ever called | BEHAVIORAL | DELIBERATELY SKIPPED (see below) |
| 7 | Wrong-flight selection | 8 t1, 23 t1 | user-sim picks a different valid flight (HAT289 vs gold HAT271) / wrong return leg → wrong DB + cascaded comms | — | DELIBERATELY SKIPPED (model/user-sim selection; no general guard) |

## Edits made this iteration (several DIFFERENT types)
| id | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E1 | code: normalization + in-body auto-correct + re-sync | `tools.py book_reservation` (+ helpers `_to_payment`, `_autocorrect_payment_amounts`) | normalize any `{id/type}` payment dict → `{payment_id,amount}`; if amounts ≠ computed total, settle them (single method pays total; else the one credit card absorbs the remainder after fixed-value methods); re-sync `payment_history` + recomputed `nonfree_baggages` before persisting (DB hashes those, not the return). General payment semantics, no task literals. | yes — verified no-op when amounts already sum (task 25 correct split unchanged); task 11 is not a booking |
| E2 | code: in-body recompute + guard | `tools.py update_reservation_baggages` | `nonfree = max(0, total − FREE[membership][cabin]×n_pax)` using the policy allowance table; charge only when `total_price>0` so a within-allowance change never fails on an unneeded `payment_id`. Pure policy arithmetic = gold. | yes — no-op on correct callers; task 11 untouched |
| E3 | code: discriminating-predicate guard | `tools.py cancel_reservation` | refuse to cancel when any flight segment is already flown (`status in {flying,landed}`), matching the policy "if any portion has been flown, cannot cancel". Blocks the exact forbidden write in task 37 t2; future-flight cancels (task 19 Z7GOZK, task 23 K1NW8N) still succeed. | yes — verified allowed cancels still work |
| E4 | prose: add clarifying rules + output contract + softness | `policy/policy.md` "Operating notes" §1–§6 | §1 match the reservation by route (decoy trap); §2 basic-economy CAN change cabin (upgrade) though its flights are locked; §3 don't transfer/refuse an in-policy action; §4 state the exact charged/refunded $ (COMMUNICATE); §5 pull DOB from profile; §6 trust the tools for amounts/baggage; softness/judgement clause in the lead-in. | reinforces task 11's already-correct exact-$ behavior; no rule flips a decision a passing task relies on |

## Verify-the-fix (replayed on live DB, `/tmp/verify.py`)
- task 25 `book_reservation` gift 128 + cc 171 (sum 299 ≠ total 375) → STORED [gift 128, cc **247**] = gold. Correct split (128/247) passes through unchanged (no-op).
- task 8-shape malformed `{'type':'certificate','id':'certificate_8045380'}` (no payment_id/amount) → STORED [cert **348**], nonfree 0 = gold.
- task 12 `update_reservation_baggages` YAX4DR total=1 nf=1 AND total=2 nf=0 → STORED nonfree **0**, **no** $50 payment appended = gold.
- task 17/22 baggage FQ8APE (economy) total=3 → STORED nonfree **0**, no payment = gold.
- task 37 `cancel_reservation(NQNU5R)` (flights `landed`) → **raises** (forbidden write blocked); `cancel(Z7GOZK)` and `cancel(K1NW8N)` (available flights) → status `cancelled` = allowed.
- registration: all **14** tools still register; `update_reservation_flights` (task-11 path) unchanged and works.

## Deliberately skipped
- **STALL / narrated-without-action (19 t1, 22 t0, 25 t2):** the tools SKILL + pitfalls state plainly that a prose "act after confirming" rule has been TRIED on this class and does NOT move it (cand_0001's §1 "execute same turn" was exactly that), and the code remedy (a composite write + `remove` the primitives) is unsafe here — cancel/update must stay refusable (task 37 must NOT cancel; basic-economy flight-change must refuse), so collapsing confirm+execute would break those. Left for a later iteration if a safe composite can be designed.
- **Wrong-flight selection (8 t1, 23 t1):** the user-sim chooses a different valid flight; no general code guard (a flight literal would overfit).
- **Multi-reservation split (23):** 3 separate single-passenger bookings is model reasoning; E1 only unblocks each individual booking's payment.

## Process & features used
- One read-only diagnosis subagent over all 30 trajectories (corrected the intake: task 37 t2 fails on an EXTRA forbidden cancel of a flown reservation, NOT a COMMUNICATE omission; `'HATHAT'` ids are tool-returned, not hallucinated). Then serial editing + live-DB verification of every code lever.
- Built on cand_0001's RESULT: it was rejected (−0.100, nothing measurably broke/fixed). I kept its two highest-confidence, gold-verified levers (payment auto-correct, baggage recompute) and DROPPED its two widest-blast-radius/refuted edits — the dict-return `payment_summary` enrichment (re-read every turn, low COMMUNICATE coverage: only tasks 11 & 23 have non-empty `communicate_info`) and the prose "execute-on-confirm same-turn" anti-STALL rule (refuted class). Added NEW levers cand_0001 lacked: the cancel-flown guard (task 37) and the decoy-reservation/basic-economy/anti-over-transfer policy clarifications (tasks 17, 22).

## Preserve
- Auto-correct / baggage recompute fire only on mismatch → correct callers are no-ops; do not make them unconditional.
- `reservation.payment_history = deepcopy(payment_methods)` AFTER auto-correct (latent stale-amount bug if removed).
- cancel-flown guard keys on flight `status in {flying,landed}` — do not broaden to delayed/cancelled (those are still cancellable per policy).
